testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/quick-order/verification-of-upload-csv-for-guest-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Quick Order > verification of upload csv for guest user

scenario.summary: Guest opens the multi-row quick order pad: a non-existent SKU shows 'The entered SKU is invalid.'; a simple product picked from the suggestion with quantity 5 is added to the cart (cart count 5); a bundle product picked from the suggestion is added (cart line shows its name); then a CSV of 7 valid SKUs uploaded on Paste Multiple fills the Quick List.
steps: Guest session (empty storageState); open the multi-row quick order pad
Enter an invalid SKU in row 0; check the row error 'The entered SKU is invalid.'; clear the row
Type the simple product SKU; check the suggestion shows '<name> | <sku>'; select it; set quantity 5; Add to Cart; check the cart heading 'Cart' and cart count 5; clear the cart
Open the pad again; type the bundle product SKU; check the suggestion '<name> | <sku>'; select it; Add to Cart; check the heading and that the cart line contains the bundle name; clear the cart
Open Paste Multiple; upload a CSV of 7 SKUs; check the alert '7 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.' and that row 0 holds the first CSV SKU
stateChanges: Guest cart gets the simple product (qty 5), is cleared, gets the bundle product, is cleared
The guest Quick List is filled from the uploaded CSV (not ordered)
assertions: Row error 'The entered SKU is invalid.' for the invalid SKU
Suggestion text contains '<name> | <sku>' for the simple and the bundle product
Cart heading 'Cart'; cart count equals the quantity entered (5)
Cart line contains the bundle product name
Alert contains '7 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.'
Quick List row 0 value equals the first CSV SKU
evidence: Title and the three step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no linked cases.
